Business visa: This visa allows you to carry out business activities, attend conferences and visit partners. The duration depends on the contract or invitation and several people can participate.

You will also need to obtain a business visa from the Saudi embassy or consulate in your country. However, just like a tourist visa, you will need a criminal record to apply for a business visa.

Transit visa: Allows a stay of up to 72 hours. You can apply online or upon arrival at the airport. As with previous visas, you will need a valid passport, but you will also need to show a confirmed flight ticket from the country of destination.

A valid visa for the destination country is also required. These are some of the visas that allow temporary stay in Saudi Arabia, but there are also more specific visas. These include Hajj visas, temporary work visas, diplomatic visas, etc.
